page.overview:
Who is Takeshi?

Takeshi, also known as Tiger Claw, is a mutant tiger assassin and bounty hunter who becomes an ally of the and an enemy of the , and the brother of in the 2012 TV series. He perfectly knows his profession, making him an extremely dangerous opponent.

As a human, Takeshi was a young Japanese boy with short straight hair and a thin figure. He wore a tank top with a star graphic on the front, shorts, and crew socks.

Tiger Claw is a mutant tiger with short orange and white fur with black stripes, pink and black skin, yellow eyes, and a large, muscular figure. He has four fingers on each hand and three toes on each foot, black claws, white whiskers on his muzzle, and a docked tail. After losing his right arm to in "Tale of Tiger Claw", he sports a mechanical arm, allowing him to change his hand into a gun, a claw, or a rocket launcher. He wears a cyan shirt with rolled up sleeves, a brown shirt vest, a double chain bullet bandolier with a jetpack, an azure scarf around his neck, a double chain bullet belt around his waist, and brown pants with pouches for his pistols on his thighs and belted bottoms that stop at his ankles. After the events of "The Wrath of Tiger Claw", he wears an eye patch over his left eye and his right ear is slightly damaged.

Given his predatory nature, Tiger Claw is fierce and cunning, finding enjoyment in hunting and outsmarting most of his enemies. As such he shares no qualms in attacking defenseless people, like when refused to harm , seeing no honor in attacking a blind person, even attempting to kill his own sister Alopex. Tiger Claw holds no such code of honor, he cares only for power and revenge. Regardless, he follows the 's orders without question, given their mutual respects.
